spec.title: Availability
spec.description: Share of Translate requests in the selected time range that the service didn't fail. A request rejected for its input, such as a text over the character limit, is the client's mistake, so it counts as available. A request that never reached the service isn't counted.

spec.title: Availability over time
spec.description: Share of Translate requests the service didn't fail, over time. Rejected requests count as available, as in Availability. Gaps mean there were no requests.

spec.title: Response time
spec.description: 50th, 95th and 99th percentile time the service took to handle a Translate request, counting the character count and OpenAI requests it makes. Estimated from the histogram buckets, so a value is only as precise as its bucket.

spec.title: Requests by status code
spec.description: Translate requests per second, by the gRPC status code the service answered with. INVALID_ARGUMENT is a rejected request, such as a text over the character limit; UNKNOWN is a failed translation.

spec.title: Requests by status code
spec.description: Requests per second to the character count service, by the gRPC status code it answered with. INVALID_ARGUMENT is a text over the character limit, which ends the Translate request before OpenAI is asked.

spec.title: Response time
spec.description: 50th, 95th and 99th percentile time a request to the character count service took, as this service saw it, including the network. Estimated from the histogram buckets.

spec.title: Translations by language
spec.description: Translations requested from OpenAI in the selected time range, per target language, failed ones included. Requests rejected before OpenAI is asked aren't counted.

spec.title: Translation rate by language
spec.description: Translations requested from OpenAI per second, per target language.

spec.title: Response time
spec.description: 50th, 95th and 99th percentile time OpenAI took to answer a translation request. It's most of a Translate request's response time. Estimated from the histogram buckets.

spec.title: Translation success rate
spec.description: Share of translation requests to OpenAI that returned a translation, over time. Requests rejected before OpenAI is asked aren't counted. Gaps mean there were no translations.

spec.title: Failed translations
spec.description: Failed translation requests to OpenAI per second, by error type and target language.

spec.title: Log volume by level
spec.description: Log lines per interval from this service, by level. A rise in warn or error lines is the first thing to look for.

spec.title: Warnings and errors
spec.description: Warning, error and critical log lines from this service, newest first. Open a line to see its details and the View trace link to the request that wrote it.

spec.title: All logs
spec.description: Every log line from this service at INFO and above, newest first. The service sends no DEBUG lines.
